changelog:
⬆️ A binary install updates itself from the admin panel: Kiro Proxy downloads the new release, checks it against the release's SHA-256 checksums, puts it in place of the running file and restarts into it when you say so, keeping you signed in. The old file stays next to it as a backup.
🐳 The update dialog shows the changes and the steps side by side, marks the way that fits your server as recommended, and gives each method numbered steps with commands you can copy.
🇯🇵 The admin panel now speaks Japanese (日本語). Chinese, Vietnamese and Brazilian Portuguese read better, and server errors, public link and alert failures, ban reasons and update errors now show in your language instead of English.
